QuestInfo.name: Shadow Ghost of the Herb Field
QuestInfo.parent: Shadow Ghost of the Herb Town
QuestInfo.0: Mr. Ku of Herb Town has a concern...
QuestInfo.1: There has been a rumor circulating around Herb Town that a shadow ghost appears in the herb gardens, so no one has been digging for herbs as of late. To get to the bottom of this, Mr. Ku would like you to bring him Ripped Scroll Pieces. Collect #b50 Ripped Scroll Pieces#k from #bGinseng Jars#k or #bJars#k and deliver them to #bMr. Ku#k.
QuestInfo.2: You've delivered 50 Ripped Scroll Pieces to Mr. Ku.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 2,105,028
Can proceed to An Old Ill-Fated Relationship of Herb Town quest

0.0: I'm going to run out of herbs soon, and no one's willing to gather them... Hm... You, there! Help me, if you're not too busy.

yes.0: There is a strange rumor circulating in Herb Town that the Herb Garden is haunted by a #bShadow Ghost#k. Because of this rumor, no one is going to gather herbs... I'm going to run out of herb medicine soon.
yes.1: I'm trying to investigate this rumor myself. According to the people who have seen the ghost, every time it appears, it leaves a #bRipped Scroll Piece#k. I suspect I can get to the bottom of this rumor by studying these pieces.
yes.2: Bring me #b50 Ripped Scroll Pieces#k. You'll be able to find the Ripped Scroll Pieces from #bGinseng Jars#k or #bJars#k.

no.0: Are you sure? You don't look THAT busy...

1.0: Ah, you've brought all the pieces I needed. I should be able to identify the ghost now. Shall we take a look?
1.1: Hmm... What's this?! Oh, no... This is going to be tricky.\r\n

item.0: This isn't enough for me to identify the Shadow Ghost. I need 50 Ripped Scroll Pieces for that.
